findings.label: Synchronous insets read on AVAILABLE open
findings.detail: On a cached-AVAILABLE open the field-scroll reads ime().bottom before Gboard has animated in, so the first keepFocusedFieldAboveKeyboard may see zero insets and skip; it self-corrects on the next insets callback via onImeVisibilityChanged. Already dispositioned 'no action required' by the logic review; not introduced or altered by this commit.
